display_long_description:
Two Incredible Ways to Play

Couch Co-Op Multiplayer
Transform your living room into the ultimate party game. Pop on your headset and start painting your masterpiece in mid-air. No extra headsets required, your friends can join the game instantly from any web browser to guess what you’re drawing.

Solo vs. AI Speed Rounds
No friends online? No problem. Face off against our custom-trained AI model in a heart-racing race against the clock!
1-Minute Blitz: You have exactly 1 minute to paint and make the AI guess as many words as possible.
100+ Word Pool: Start with easy prompts and adapt as the words get progressively more challenging.
Risk vs. Reward: Stuck on a word? You can skip it, but it will cost you a strategic time penalty.
Global Leaderboard: Perfect your spatial drawing skills and beat out other painters worldwide for the top spot!
